mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leaderboard_snapshot (source, topic_name, period, snapshot_date, data_json) VALUES (#{source}, #{topicName}, #{period}, #{snapshotDate}, #{dataJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data_json = VALUES(data_json), create_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, topic_name AS topicName, period, snapshot_date AS snapshotDate, data_json AS dataJson, create_time AS createTime FROM leaderboard_snapshot WHERE source = #{source} AND (topic_name = #{topicName} OR (#{topicName} IS NULL AND topic_name IS NULL)) AND period = #{period} AND data_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
